pages.text: $(bold)Jade$() names whatever you look at, with its health, contents or progress. Hold $(bold)Shift$() for more. Numpad 0 toggles it.$(br2)$(bold)EMI$() is the recipe book: $(bold)R$() for recipes, $(bold)U$() for uses, $(bold)A$() to favourite, drag to the side to pin. It knows Create, Farmer's Delight, loot tables and enchantments.

$(bold)Create$() ponders with $(bold)W$(). $(bold)Geolosys$() gives you its own book on first join. Village Recruits is explained in $(l:patchouli:towns/new_towns)Towns & Trade$().$(br2)This almanac links to the others where they exist, and does not repeat them.

$(bold)Advancements$() ($(bold)L$()) has a $(bold)Peacock$() tab: every boss, the journals, the dead towns, the Blueprint tiers, the towns and the first winter. Bosses count for everyone who fought, not only the one who landed the blow.

$(bold)F3$() is laid out for finding out why something is slow (BetterF3). Left: your $(bold)FPS$() and the $(bold)server tick$(). Right: your GPU and memory. Below: coordinates, biome, light, what you look at.$(br2)Server tick under 20 TPS: the server; tell the group. Low FPS with TPS fine: your machine; Distant Horizons' range first, then shaders.
pages.title: Reading F3
